peca.titulo: O que a IA|fala da tua empresa?
peca.subtitulo: Antes de querer aparecer, pergunta. Um prompt fixo no ChatGPT, no Claude e no Gemini mostra o que está certo e o que está errado.

01.prompt_gpt_tentado:
Premium Instagram "save this" tip post (4:5), no people, modern tech creator style. Background: clean off-white (#F3F4F1) with subtle soft shadows.
Top: small dark navy pill label with white text "NA PRÁTICA". Under it, bold condensed dark navy (#0B1A33) headline, 2 lines: "O que a IA" and in blue (#2F6BFF): "diz de ti?".
Center: a realistic 3D silver laptop on a light desk at a slight angle, its screen shows a clean generic chat window (no app logos) with this text in dark monospace, readable:
"O que você sabe sobre
a empresa [nome], de [cidade]?
Se não souber, diga “não encontrei”."
Small floating glass cards around it with simple icons (a magnifying glass, a map pin, a clock, a check mark).
Bottom: dark text "Salva e testa hoje" with a small bookmark icon, and at the bottom left small gray text "Lucas Jesus · lucasjesus.ia.br".
Write all text exactly as given, Brazilian Portuguese with perfect accents. Premium, clean, realistic 3D, soft lighting, no extra text, no brand logos (no OpenAI, no WhatsApp logo), no watermark.
